from collections import deque, defaultdict
R=C=30
g=[[6]*C for _ in range(R)]
# walls
for r in range(0,7): g[r][8]=4
for c in range(9): g[6][c]=4
for r in range(0,15): g[r][22]=4
for c in range(13,23): g[14][c]=4
for r in range(14,22): g[r][13]=4
g[21]=[4]*30
for r in range(21,30): g[r][22]=4
# markers
for r,c,v in [(4,6,7),(5,7,2),(11,19,7),(12,20,2),(13,21,8),(15,14,7),(16,15,9),(18,25,8),(19,24,1),(20,23,5),(22,21,7),(23,20,3),(24,19,8),(28,24,3),(29,23,8)]:g[r][c]=v
# components
seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if g[r][c]==4 or (r,c) in seen: continue
  q=deque([(r,c)]);seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
  while q:
   x,y=q.popleft();comp.append((x,y))
   for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
    a,b=x+dx,y+dy
    if 0<=a<R and 0<=b<C and g[a][b]!=4 and (a,b) not in seen:
     seen.add((a,b));q.append((a,b))
  comps.append(comp)
for i,comp in enumerate(comps):
 cells=set(comp)
 bd=[p for p in comp if any((p[0]+dx,p[1]+dy) not in cells for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)])]
 dist={p:0 for p in bd};q=deque(bd)
 while q:
  p=q.popleft()
  for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
   z=(p[0]+dx,p[1]+dy)
   if z in cells and z not in dist:dist[z]=dist[p]+1;q.append(z)
 marks=defaultdict(list)
 for p in comp:
  if g[p[0]][p[1]]!=6: marks[dist[p]].append((p,g[p[0]][p[1]]))
 print(i, len(comp), 'bbox', (min(x for x,y in comp),max(x for x,y in comp),min(y for x,y in comp),max(y for x,y in comp)), 'maxd',max(dist.values()),'marks',dict(marks))
